title: PM <> Eng 1:1 prep - Jordan & Samira
content:
Date: 2026-03-04
Attendees: Jordan (PM), Samira (Eng Lead)
Duration: 30m
Primary goal: quick sync on near-term work across API / Console / Dedicated / Private and surface any blockers that need exec/infra support. Leave with clear action items and owners.

Top priorities to check (TL;DR)
- Hosted API v2 rollout: finish canary + traffic ramp (target: 3/10) — need infra for 2% -> 10% burst policy.
- Console: rollout of per-route cost/latency charts for tenants (beta) — close UX edge cases, storage retention question.
- Dedicated: autoscaling policy revamp prototype ready for load test (blocked on e2e test infra).
- Private: onboarding checklist for new enterprise customer (legal + KMS integration).

Agenda
1) Quick wins / blockers (5m)
2) Hosted API rollout status + infra request (8m)
3) Console beta feedback & next steps (7m)
4) Dedicated autoscale test plan (5m)
5) Private onboarding checklist & owner confirmations (3m)

Notes / prompts for each item
1) Quick wins / blockers- Reminder: small latency regression on qkv cache path reported by SRE (ticket PROD-456). Samira: any ETA on patch?- Note to self: validate alert thresholds after patch — staging looked OK but want to avoid noisy alerts during canary.

2) Hosted API rollout- Current: canary at 2% traffic; performance looks stable for 2k token workloads but tail p95 increased by ~30ms for long-context (2k+ tokens).- Ask: can we get temporary burst capacity for 1 week to test 10% for regional bursts? (needs infra approval and cost estimate).- Risk: if tail latency persists, need fallback policy to smaller context model for 2k+ requests. Decision needed: enable automatic fallback or hold ramp.- Linked: JIRA-7890 (performance investigation), PR #456 (runtime kv-cache fix).

3) Console beta (per-route charts)- UX feedback from beta tenant: chart granularity too coarse, users want drilldown to token-level cost for last 7 days. Backend storage cost concern if we increase resolution.- Options: 1) keep current resolution + add sampling API for high-fidelity; 2) increase resolution for paid customers only. Discuss tradeoffs.- Action: ask analytics infra for cost delta estimate (Samira or Alex to ping infra analytics).

4) Dedicated autoscale prototype- Status: prototype ready, but e2e load-test harness missing multi-tenant simulation. Without tests, we can't validate fairness and isolation.- Blocker: SRE ticket open for test env quota (PROD-501). Who can escalate?- Short-term mitigation: manual smoke tests + limited canary with selected customers.

5) Private onboarding checklist- Legal: NDA signed? (customer says yes, need copy).- KMS: customer uses AWS KMS — verify key policy and cross-account access (task for infra).- Audit logs: confirm retention and export locations.- Action: create single checklist doc in Confluence and assign owners. I will draft and request review.

Decisions needed in this meeting- Approve temporary burst capacity for Hosted API canary -> Samira to confirm feasibility and cost estimate by 3/06.- Approach for Console high-res charts: pick sampling + paid upsell approach to avoid storage blowup (tentative).

Action items (owner / due)- Samira: provide burst capacity feasibility + rough cost estimate for 10% ramp (due 2026-03-06).- Jordan: draft Confluence onboarding checklist and paste in #cs-private channel for review (due 2026-03-05).- Alex Morgan: ping analytics infra for storage cost estimate for increasing chart resolution (due 2026-03-06).- Samira: escalate PROD-501 to SRE and get ETA for quota increase (due 2026-03-05).- Jordan & Samira: decide fallback policy for long-context tail latency (enable automatic model fallback vs pause ramp) — decide by 2026-03-07.

Open questions / follow-ups- If we enable fallback, how will we surface to customers? (need messaging + console indicator).- What rolling window should we use for per-route sampling to support on-demand high fidelity?

Quick notes / talking points- Emphasize customer impact: priority customers running long-context (>2k) pipelines.- Risk tolerance: for Hosted API rollout, prefer conservative ramp with safety nets (fallback + alerting).- Keep Dedicated customers informed about autoscale timeline — they expect SLA improvements.

Wrap / agenda for next 1:1- Status updates on the action items above.- Post-mortem plan if canary sees regressed p95 during ramp.

Scratch / misc- Slack refs: #prod-hosted-api, #infra-analytics, #sre-oncall.- Tickets referenced: PROD-456, JIRA-7890, PROD-501.- PR to watch: github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/456

Notes to self: keep this short in meeting, focus on asking for confirmations and owners. If Samira is blocked on infra escalation, offer to sync with infra head to unblock.
